name: Coolwatch
author: Dan Jones
description: Coolify in your Omarchy bar, fast and native. One icon, one keyboard-first panel: every server, resource and deployment with live status, one-key deploy, restart, stop and cancel, build and container logs, and toasts the moment a build queues, finishes or fails. Cloud or self-hosted, several instances at once, REST API only: no daemon, no SSH, nothing to babysit.
